deviations.reason: 17 of 33 write-recovery tasks are scored on invariant keys (invariants{key: true}) and 3 on sequence[] / outcomes[] fields that neither the prompt nor answerShape names; 31 tasks are critical. Without the keys, a correct agent fails on shape and the critical-failure gate fails for both arms
deviations.rule: runners pass answer-contract.json[taskId] to the agent with prompt and answerShape, identically for every arm; it names result fields neutrally (outcome | error | status for every task) and asks each invariant as a yes/no question; no expected value is revealed
deviations.approvalConditions: entries contain only field names, neutral yes/no invariant questions and the fill-whichever-the-service-returned instruction; no expected values, counts, uids, digests or outcomes; mechanical leak check in build-answer-contract.mjs --check; identical entry to both arms; write-pass runners read only tasks.json and answer-contract.json

leakCheck.method: every gold leaf value except invariant keys (24 values) matched case-insensitively on word boundaries against the serialized contract; exit 3 on any hit; negative probes BKS_PLAN_FORGED / duplicate / applied each failed the check as intended

deviations.reason: The lead's runner brief started the arm executors without the admission module (BKS_ADMISSION_ENABLED unset), so the revocation routes WR-16 needs returned 404 in both arms. This is an environment defect of the evaluation, not a property of the skills or the service.
deviations.rule: Each arm restarts its executor once with BKS_ADMISSION_ENABLED=1, BKS_ADMISSION_LEDGER_CREATE=1, a file grant registry for its local-dev scope and BKS_LOCAL_DEV_ROLE=admin, then runs WR-16 again. The scorer reads WR-16 from <run>/<ARM>/WR-16-rerun/answer.json for both arms; the original <ARM>/WR-16/answer.json is kept unedited with an ERRATA.md pointer. No other task is rerun.
